method: Fixed Ridge alpha=10. Earlier seasons train; preceding season calibrates residuals; refit on both. Features update only after UTC day ends. No test-season tuning.
limitations: One completed test season per league; incomplete 2026-27 reported separately. VTB current-team cohort. No in-play support, odds, injuries, domestic-league games or cold-start-specific calibration. Retrospective results are not prospective accuracy.
